import pandas as pd

def generate_test_case(test_case_id):
    def generate_ans(data):
        df = data
        for col in df.columns:
            vc = df[col].value_counts()
            if col == "Qu1":
                df[col] = df[col].apply(
                    lambda x: x if vc[x] >= 3 or x == "apple" else "other"
                )
            else:
                df[col] = df[col].apply(
